Adolion: House Nightriver
Author view
Overview
Memory
⚑
Where you are
Days Before the Trial
The Trial is only days off and nobody will say why it was arranged this way. The house and the Academy are full of people who might know.
The scene is tense.
About this story
You are an heir of House Nightriver, home in Aegis City for the Aegis Academy's mid-year recess, the week of the Mid-Year Ball. Your bloodline carries the seals that keep the Witch King asleep, a secret the house keeps from the world. Expect court intrigue, a cold father, and danger that is real: a wrong word or a lost fight can cost a life. Make your persona a Nightriver heir with a spark of seal-born magic.
Recently
You left The Household Assembled behind and moved into Days Before the Trial.
Open threads
Whether Welden's knowledge of the cracking anchors and the Witch King's calling will be shared or suppressed.
Whether Javon's delay of the blood binding is deliberate and what he is waiting for.
Whether Shiya's voiced suspicion that the house's troubles are connected will push her to act.
Whether Welden's confession about the Witch King calling will reach Javon or be acted upon.
Whether Max will confront Javon about the delayed blood binding Welden described.
The story so far
During the Nightriver family's mid-year reunion, Lord Javon revealed to his son Max that the estate's seals were failing, the bloodline was thinning, and King Alexander had decreed that one of his children must wed a Great House heir by year's end, with Javon chosen to arrange the match for House Nightriver. Javon warned that a royal advisor named Kane would arrive the next day and that the Witch King was not the only threat to the family from within.
